scenario_name: Remediating DNS Hijacking and Phishing Redirection
base_template: Write a critical incident report from the IT Helpdesk (3-4 sentences). Explain that staff trying to access {{internal_domain}} are being redirected to a suspicious phishing site at {{phishing_ip}}. State that the router's DNS settings were compromised and must be pointed back to the trusted server {{trusted_dns}}.

internal_domain.instruction: Generate a unique internal domain (e.g., portal.corp.local, intranet.tech.io)

trusted_dns.instruction: A standard trusted DNS IP (e.g., 8.8.8.8 or an internal 10.x.x.x)

expected_solution: Correct the 'ip name-server' entries, disable 'ip dns server' if not needed, and implement an ACL to allow DNS traffic only to trusted servers.
